name: Tiffin Run
summary: A food delivery tracker whose order sheet snaps to peek, half and full over a live city map
about: A phone screen for tracking a food order, with a bottom sheet that springs between three heights while a rider moves along the route on the map behind it. As the sheet rises the map slides, dims and blurs, and the grip turns into a down arrow. The sheet holds a live order timeline, call and message buttons, tip chips with a real total, the receipt, and a delivered finish with confetti and a star rating.
how: Drag the grip or the top of the sheet up and down, or flick it: it snaps to peek, half or full with a spring and stretches past the ends.
Press the grip (Enter or Space) to step through the heights; Arrow Up and Arrow Down move one height, Escape drops it back to peek. A mouse wheel works too.
At full height the receipt scrolls; pull down from its top to lower the sheet again.
Pick a tip to update the total, press Call or Message to reach the rider, and rate the ride when the order is delivered, then press Track another.
